caption: The drawing depicts an architectural capital with intricate carvings. The main features are a series of stylized plant motifs, resembling sheaves of wheat or large leaves, radiating outward from the center. Among the foliage, there are two birds prominently featured; one bird is centrally positioned facing downward with wings slightly opened, while another bird is partially visible behind the foliage to the left. The capital is topped with a horizontal band, which is decorated with a simple linear pattern. The artwork is rendered primarily in beige, brown, and gray tones, emphasizing the texture and depth of the carving against a plain, light-colored background. The composition centralizes the carved capital with no additional objects or ornamentation surrounding it.
title: Architectural Ornament
